title: The Kubernetes API answers unauthenticated
summary: The Kubernetes API server returns its version to an unauthenticated caller, which usually means the cluster can be read or controlled.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("gitVersion") and body_contains("goVersion") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Require authentication and authorization on the API server.
